title: Harnessing Artificial Intelligence to Combat Online Hate: Exploring the Challenges and Opportunities of Large Language Models in Hate Speech Detection

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLM error rates in classifying directed hate speech and non-hateful speech targeting women using the HateCheck dataset.
Analyzing model classification error rates for hate and non-hate speech directed at gay individuals.
Assessing classification performance and error rates on hate speech directed at trans individuals.
Measuring hate speech classification accuracy and error rates for texts targeting immigrants.
Evaluating LLM error rates in detecting hate speech specifically directed at Black individuals.
Assessing detection performance and error rates on hate speech directed at Muslims.
Evaluating the classifier's sensitivity and error rate for hate speech targeted at disabled people.
Testing LLMs on non-hateful examples containing swear words, slurs, negations, or group identifiers to evaluate if models inappropriately flag them as hate speech based purely on vocabulary.
